title: Find the well-stocked categories
prompt: Look only at products that are not discontinued and that have a category. For each category_id with at least 3 such products, return category_id, products (how many) and avg_price (their average price, rounded to 2 decimal places). Sort by category_id.
hints: Which test is about single products, and which is about a whole group?
Tests on rows go in WHERE, before GROUP BY. The test on the count goes in HAVING, after it.
WHERE discontinued = false AND category_id IS NOT NULL GROUP BY category_id HAVING count(*) >= 3

wrongAnswers.misconception: Leaves out the row filter, so discontinued products are counted.
Keeps only groups with more than 3 products.

feedback: Count the products of one category by hand, leaving out discontinued ones, and compare with your result.
